text.p: IMPORTANT NOTE: The log-level-stderr option default has been changed from warn to off. This makes it easier to capture errors when only redirecting stdout. To preserve the prior behavior set log-level-stderr=warn.
NOTE TO PACKAGERS: The lz4 library is now required by the meson build.
NOTE TO PACKAGERS: Compiler support for __builtin_clzl() and __builtin_bswap64() is now required by the meson build.

release-item.p: Fix SFTP renaming failure when file already exists.
Some SFTP servers report that a file already exists with an error that was not handled, so renaming a file over an existing file failed.

commit.subject: Refactor lock module.
Add remote locks for stanza commands missed in 31c7824a.
Allow backups to run concurrently on different repositories.

release-item.p: Allow backups to run concurrently on different repositories.
Backups of the same stanza can now run at the same time on different repositories, since locks are now per stanza and repository instead of per stanza. This is not possible for <= 9.5.
Support IP-based SANs for TLS certificate validation.
Certificates with an IP address as the subject alternative name, e.g. IP:1.2.3.4, are now validated. IPv4 and IPv6 addresses must match exactly.
Default log-level-stderr option to off.
Warnings and errors written to stderr were often lost when only stdout was redirected while collecting logs. An explicitly set log-level-stderr is not affected.

commit.subject: Allow alternative WAL segment sizes for PostgreSQL <= 10.

release-item.p: Allow alternative WAL segment sizes for PostgreSQL ≤ 10.
<= 10 can be built with a different WAL segment size, and forks such as Greenplum set it with initdb.
Add hint to check SFTP authorization log.
When SFTP authentication fails the error now hints that the authorization log on the server may have more detail.
Display time option defaults and allowed values with appropriate units.

Time option defaults and allowed values were shown in seconds, which was hard to read for large values. Fractional seconds are no longer allowed, so a value such as archive-timeout=0.5 must be written as archive-timeout=500ms.

commit.subject: Require OpenSSL >= 1.1.1.

release-item.p: Require OpenSSL >= 1.1.1.

commit.subject: Require compiler support for __builtin_clzl() and __builtin_bswap64().
Require the lz4 library in the meson build.

release-item.p: Require the lz4 library and compiler builtins in the meson build.

commit.subject: Fix invalid default inherited in job-retry-interval.
Add units to all option sizes.
Improve error messages for allow range and allow list options.

release-item.p: Improve option units, defaults, and error messages.

commit.subject: Optimize assignment of command/option rules.
Remove PARSE_RULE_OPTION_GROUP_MEMBER() macro from parse.auto.c.inc.
Shorten enums used in parse.auto.c.inc.
Improve command/role parsing.

release-item.p: Improve option and command parsing.

commit.subject: Avoid possible race condition while reading lock files in info command.
Simplify lock file scanning in stop command.

release-item.p: Improve reading lock files in the info and stop commands.

commit.subject: Improve efficiency of incremental manifest build.
Refactor backup to use flag for backup standby state rather than option.
Replace strftime() with cvtTimeToZP() and strNew/CatTimeP().

release-item.p: Refactor the backup and manifest code.

commit.subject: Replace tabs with spaces in meson.build files.
Fix overly long lines.

release-item.p: Fix formatting.
Clarify archive-push multi-repo behavior.
When one repository is failing, archive-push cannot push ahead to the other repositories unless archive-async is enabled.

commit.subject: Clarify when code generation is run when modifying config.yaml.
Remove references to mock integration tests.
Fix incorrect examples in doc/test help.
Improve config file handling in doc/test config load.

release-item.p: Update the contributing documentation and the documentation and test tools.

commit.subject: Migrate coverage testing to C and remove dependency on lcov.
Fix --run and --scale options for unit tests.
Increase width of unsigned integration in performance/type module.
Auto-generate code before building test binary.

release-item.p: Migrate coverage testing to C and remove dependency on lcov.

Specify test images that get valgrind installed.

release-item.p: CI updates.

Fix issue with files larger on the replica than on the primary.
